criteria.reasoning: The report structure is clear and has an executive summary. However, Wikipedia is explicitly cited in violation of instructions, figure captions are cut off/unformatted, and an incomplete sentence appears under EOL.

technical_issues.issue: SSO launches from Kourou typically require dogleg maneuvers or southerly trajectories rather than benefiting from equatorial prograde velocity gain.
No technical decay calculation or sail area sizing provided to verify compliance with the 25-year LEO disposal guideline from a 600 km altitude.

overall: A solid, well-motivated report addressing all core mission segments. Improvements are needed in quantitative deorbit analysis, avoiding prohibited sources like Wikipedia, and tidying presentation/formatting defects.

feedback.summary: You produced a well-motivated preliminary design for ZYZZsat with clear mission rationale and appropriate software tools like STK. Your introduction and conclusion successfully synthesised mission objectives and trade-offs. To reach higher marks, provide quantitative engineering calculations for end-of-life deorbiting and orbital manoeuvres, and address presentation flaws such as incomplete sentences, truncated captions, and non-academic citations.
next_steps: Include explicit calculations for end-of-life disposal (such as drag sail area sizing and lifetime decay models) to prove compliance with the 25-year LEO guideline.
Detail required orbital manoeuvres or injection tolerances, accounting for specific launch constraints such as dogleg manoeuvres for SSO from Kourou.
Audit your bibliography and formatting to eliminate non-peer-reviewed sources like Wikipedia, fix incomplete sentences, and properly format all figure captions.

criteria.C1: You provided a comprehensive rationale for ZYZZsat, clearly identifying stakeholders (CSIRO, BOM) and justifying the single-satellite architecture. Your literature context was well integrated.
criteria.C2: You covered core mission aspects using STK, but reached Adequate because orbital manoeuvres and deorbit mechanics lacked quantitative depth. To reach Accomplished, calculate drag sail sizing and orbital decay timelines from 600 km, address propulsion needs, and accurately evaluate launch trajectory physics.
criteria.C3: Your conclusion concisely synthesised major design selections and trade-offs, appropriately acknowledging external risks such as the development timeline of the Vega E launch vehicle.
criteria.C4: The report follows a logical engineering structure with an executive summary. To reach Accomplished, remove prohibited sources like Wikipedia from your bibliography, resolve truncated figure captions, and fix incomplete sentences such as the trailing quote in Mission Duration & EOL.
